_comment: Hoenn & Seek 2.0 part 25a: follow-the-lights paths. tools/hoenn/gen_hoenn_lights.py finds the shortest walkable route from start to end on the layout and puts a stop every `spacing` steps (and one at the end); it writes src/data/hoenn_light_paths.h for src/hoenn_lights.c, which explains the mechanic. The light is the map object `local_id` (placed at `start` in its map.json). `near`: how close (in tiles, any direction) the player must come before the light drifts on; `lost`: how far away the player may get once it has started before the lights scatter back to the start. `stage_var` is a VAR_TEMP_* the map's own scripts don't use. Keep `spacing` at 6 or less so the next stop is on screen. The Lanturn lights (Lugia, plan section 8) are meant to be another entry here.
